name: apple-docs-mcp-next
description: MCP server for Apple Developer Documentation: API reference, Human Interface Guidelines, App Store Connect Help, sample code and 1,700 WWDC sessions with transcripts and code, on Bun

scripts.ci: bun check && bun run lint:md && bun run test
scripts.types:captured: bun run scripts/capture-responses.ts && bun run types:captured:generate
scripts.types:captured:generate: quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level SearchStream --out src/types/captured/search-stream.gen.ts api-map/responses/*.messages.json && quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level SearchDocument --out src/types/captured/search-document.gen.ts api-map/responses/*.document.json && quicktype --lang ts --src-lang json --just-types --no-enums --no-date-times --no-uuids --no-integer-strings --no-boolean-strings --top-level TechnologiesPage --out src/types/captured/technologies.gen.ts api-map/responses/technologies.json
scripts.types:docc: openapi-typescript https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swiftlang/swift-docc/main/Sources/SwiftDocC/SwiftDocC.docc/Resources/RenderNode.spec.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/types/docc/render-node.gen.ts && openapi-typescript https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swiftlang/swift-docc/main/Sources/SwiftDocC/SwiftDocC.docc/Resources/RenderIndex.spec.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/types/docc/render-index.gen.ts
scripts.verify: bun run --sequential format:check typecheck lint guard test
